title: A/P Detail: a vendor credit links to the return it came from
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations: your current location and your other location.
  • Have a vendor with three unused vendor credits: vendor credit A from a vendor return made at your current location, vendor credit B from a vendor return made at your other location, and vendor credit C not from a vendor return.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with that vendor ticked and its rows showing.
custom_steps:
1. Look at the three vendor credits' numbers.
  2. Click vendor credit A's number.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Vendor credit A's number is a link.
  • Vendor credit B's (another location) and vendor credit C's (no vendor return) are plain text.

Step 2:

  • The vendor return vendor credit A came from opens.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 11 (5 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 10 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can)

  • S7-R9: “On A/P Detail and A/P Unpaid Invoices, a vendor credit's number links to the vendor return it came from, under the same rules and permissions as a bill (S7-R6). A vendor credit that did not come from a vendor return shows as plain text.”
  • S7-R6: “A bill at the user's current location opens its delivery, as today. A bill at another location shows as plain text, because the bill page cannot switch location.”
